subject: Initial operator onramp & API provisioning for MediSure Health
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tara Bhat <tara.bhat@medisurehealth.com>, Alice Jones <alice.jones@medisurehealth.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Initial operator onramp & API provisioning for MediSure Health

Hi Tara / Alice —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. To keep momentum on the pilot, I wanted to outline the initial operator onramp so our implementation team can start provisioning your tenant and API access this week. Attached are a draft mutual action plan (Medisure-MAP-v1.xlsx) and the SOW we discussed.

High-level next steps (proposed):
- Customer to confirm admin owners (names + emails) who should receive org-admin invites.
- Redwood to seed one admin API key scoped to the project namespace for initial validation (ephemeral + rotate on activation).
- Create project namespace: medisure-prod-pilot and an implementation role (redwood-impl) with restricted write/seed privileges.
- Provide SOC2 and KMS integration notes (you requested KMS; we can add a KMS onboarding checklist).

Proposed timeline:
- Today / Tue: sign SOW or confirm changes.
- Wed: Redwood seeds first admin API key and sends invites.
- Thu: smoke test with your infra (sample call + logs).

Can you confirm the two admin contacts and whether your security team prefers HSM/KMS integration during the pilot or after initial validation? I’ve cc’d Monica (CS) and Ben (Implementation) who will run the handoff.

Attachments: Medisure-MAP-v1.xlsx, SOW-draft-Redwood.pdf

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
 diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Tara Bhat <tara.bhat@medisurehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alice Jones <alice.jones@medisurehealth.com>, procurement@medisurehealth.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial operator onramp & API provisioning for MediSure Health

Diego —

Thanks for the clear plan. Confirming our initial admin contacts:
- Tara Bhat (tara.bhat@medisurehealth.com) — Program lead
- Alice Jones (alice.jones@medisurehealth.com) — Platform owner

Procurement is cc'd for SOW review; they may request updated terms around data residency but should be quick. On KMS: we would prefer to validate the pilot with Redwood-managed keys first, then enable our cloud KMS (AWS KMS) on go-live. Can you provide the KMS integration notes you mentioned? Also need a short checklist for security to attach to our internal review.

Timeline looks fine; please seed the admin API key as ephemeral and send the invites to the two contacts. We have a small sandbox that can take initial smoke tests on Thursday morning PST.

Thanks,
Tara
Director of Platform Programs | MediSure Health
 tara.bhat@medisurehealth.com

Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Initial operator onramp & API provisioning for MediSure Health

Diego / Ben / Rishi —

Thanks Diego — looping in implementation owner Ben (cc) and infra contact Rishi to own the seeding steps. Proposed internal handoff plan:

1) Pre-provision (today): Ben to create project namespace medisure-prod-pilot in our staging cluster and prepare the role template (redwood-impl).
2) Seed key (Wed AM): Ben to create a scoped admin API key (ephemeral token, 48h TTL) and post instructions to the secure share.
3) Invite (Wed AM): Send org-admin invites to Tara and Alice (they accept to claim admin).
4) Smoke test (Thu 09:00 PST): perform a sample generate/embedding call and verify token-level logs in Console.
5) Security artifacts (Wed): Rishi to drop the SOC2 extracts and KMS integration notes (short doc) into the HubSpot deal record.

Ben — can you confirm you have bandwidth to run the seed and invite steps Wednesday morning PST? If not, propose an alternate owner. I’ve attached a short api-seed-checklist.md to help the team.

Diego — once Ben confirms, I’ll send Tara a calendar invite for the Thu smoke test and share the HubSpot link.

—Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
 monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0104

All —

I’m good to run the seed and invite workflow Wednesday morning PST. Plan and notes:

- Wed 08:30 PST: create project medisure-prod-pilot in staging, attach role template redwood-impl.
- Wed 09:00 PST: create scoped admin API key (label: medisure-impl-ephemeral), TTL 48h. I will upload the key stub to the secure share and send the invite email to Tara + Alice with step-by-step accept/rotate instructions.
- Wed 10:00 PST: Rishi, please drop SOC2 snippets and the KMS integration short doc to the HubSpot deal so I can point security to it during the smoke test.

Attachments: api-seed-checklist.md (checklist + curl example for a sample token call).

Tara / Alice — after the key is seeded I will send the invite and we’ll confirm the smoke test appointment for Thu 09:00 PST. If you need the key to be created with a different label or TTL, let me know.

—Ben
